prompt: A single precisely specified standard trash-can icon for a native desktop file context menu, matching thin rounded line window controls. Simple monochrome black line art on a transparent square canvas, centered with generous even margins: small top handle, horizontal lid, slightly tapered bin body, two thin vertical marks inside. Clean hollow shapes, consistent medium-thin rounded strokes and corners. Flat vector-like artwork, no text, no shadow, no gradients, no decorations. Must remain immediately readable at 16 by 16 pixels. Draw only one trash can.
selectedRationale: A specified standard trash glyph, generated directly to make recoverable deletion recognizable in the compact file menu.
